At rho=1 reciprocal-log curvature follows by splitting series at log_q 1/t. For rho>1 bilateral periodization gives a nonconstant positive G with a nonzero beta-function Fourier coefficient; graph-coordinate gluing proves geometric C2 even at flat tips. Independently checked at high-precision the normal-radius sum and bilateral G phase normalization at four log phases with q=2.4, rho=1.44, 100 geometric scales; G phase samples unequal. Analytic uniform-tail and gamma-function nonvanishing, not the finite checks, establish nonconstant G and global C2.
